title: Run VOX smoke with configured local providers
description: Allow the isolated VOX Electron smoke to use the existing configured OS keychain only when explicitly requested, so the runtime can prove the real provider-backed checkpoint without weakening the safe default test setup.
businessContext: The current VOX smoke always enables an empty in-memory keychain, which deterministically stops Idea Lab before testing the configured 9Router and downstream media path. V1 requires reuse of existing configured providers and truthful runtime evidence.
dependencies: existing configured provider credentials and certifications
existing voice, image, FFmpeg, and packaging services
acceptanceCriteria: The smoke launcher keeps the empty in-memory keychain as its safe default and uses the configured OS keychain only when LSF_UI_USE_CONFIGURED_KEYCHAIN=1 is explicitly set.
The configured-keychain smoke runs the existing vox-simple-flow mode and records provider availability, production checkpoints, and final MP4 verification truthfully.
No credential, token, or secret is written to the report or logs by this change.
Targeted smoke, typecheck, and diff checks pass, or the report records a truthful configured-runtime blocker.
humanEscalationConditions: The configured OS keychain cannot be safely read without exposing or changing credentials.
The configured provider path is unavailable and the remaining blocker requires a user-owned external configuration change.
